about.title: Accelerating Regulatory & Dossier Submissions
about.p1: Our platform is engineered specifically to simplify and accelerate the preparation, management, and regulatory submission of pharmaceutical dossiers. Designed to meet industry standards, we bridge the gap between complex legal requirements and efficient digital workflows.
about.p2: Whether you are managing multi-country product submissions, tracking contract lifecycles, or monitoring subscription tariffs and document sequences, our centralized portal gives your team total control with 24/7 access, guaranteed security, and an intuitive interface built for rapid adaptation.

pricing.title: Flexible Regulatory Plans Built for Enterprise Scale
pricing.desc: Select the optimal subscription tier for your organization's dossier volume and regulatory submission frequency.
pricing.tier1Desc: Ideal for single-product submissions and small pharmaceutical distributors.
pricing.tier2Desc: Designed for growing pharma companies managing multiple regional products.
pricing.tier3Desc: Tailored for international pharmaceutical holding corporations and government submissions.

process.title: Streamlined 4-Step Submission Process
process.desc: From raw technical documentation to official regulatory validation in Kazakhstan and EAEU region.
process.step1Desc: Import or build your eCTD structure according to state regulatory requirements.
process.step2Desc: Automated XML validation and document integrity verification before submission.
process.step3Desc: Collaborate with legal and regulatory experts within secure, role-restricted workspaces.
process.step4Desc: Submit directly to regulatory authorities with digital signature and complete audit trails.
